feed.terms: Free to use, no key needed. Attribution requested. Rate limits exist only to protect the service from abuse.

unit_note: All prices are in aUEC, Star Citizen's in-game currency (not real money), per unit.

current.sample_note: Based on 1 listing from 1 seller on SC Market.

summary: As of 2026-11-01, the lowest asking price in SC Market player listings for A03 "Canuto" Sniper Rifle is 1,000,000 aUEC, based on 1 listing from 1 seller. Too few sellers for a typical price (low confidence). aUEC is Star Citizen's in-game currency.

methodology.text: Asking prices of SC Market player listings (player-to-player offers on SC Market only, not an in-game or market-wide price), in aUEC (Star Citizen's in-game currency) per unit. Counted: active, public, fixed-price listings sold per unit, at least 24 hours old, in stock and priced above 1 aUEC (placeholders); test accounts are excluded. Each seller counts once per item, at its lowest ask. With 4 or more sellers, outliers outside 1.5x the interquartile range of the log prices are excluded. A median is shown only with 3+ sellers (confidence: low below 3 sellers, medium below 6, high from 6); the 30-day median and change need 7+ days of daily medians (snapshot once a day, UTC); a sale median needs 3+ completed SC Market orders in 30 days. These are asking prices, not in-game terminal prices.

attribution: Data: SC Market player listings (https://sc-market.space). Please credit SC Market and link to the item's page when citing.
